chunks: God is sufficient, and sufficient is His Messenger.
And sufficient is the Commander of the Faithful.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the phrase 'Kafa billahi wa kafa bi-rasulihi' in Shia theology?
ai.summary: This declaration, known as the 'Hadith al-Thaqalayn' or similar sufficiency formulas, is central to Shia theology, asserting the divine appointment and infallibility of the Imams as the successors to the Prophet. In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq utilizes this to establish the continuity of authority (Wilayah) from the Prophet to Imam Ali and the subsequent Imams, serving as a foundational proof for their spiritual and political leadership.
